speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you have unusual beliefs about telepathic communication with animals; have these thoughts been present for more than two weeks, and do they interfere with your daily life?

To better understand the nature of these experiences, could you describe exactly what happens when you believe you are communicating with the animals?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Somatic Type (with themes of special abilities/telepathy)
